items.source: Unlike declaring RuntimeHintsRegistrar using META-INF/spring/aot.factories, this annotation allows for more flexible registration where it is only processed if the annotated component or bean method is actually registered in the bean factory. items.source: If the configuration class above is processed, MyHints will be contributed only if MyCondition matches. If the condition does not match, MyService will not be defined as a bean and the hints will not be processed either.
items.translation: 如果处理上述配置类，仅当 `MyCondition` 匹配时才会贡献 `MyHints`。如果条件不匹配，则不会将 `MyService` 定义为 Bean，也不会处理提示。

items.source: @ImportRuntimeHints can also be applied to any test class that uses the Spring TestContext Framework to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: @ImportRuntimeHints 也可应用于任何使用 Spring TestContext Framework 加载 ApplicationContext 的测试类。

items.source: If several components or test classes refer to the same RuntimeHintsRegistrar implementation, the registrar will only be invoked once for the given bean factory processing or test suite.
items.translation: 如果多个组件或测试类引用了同一个 RuntimeHintsRegistrar 实现，则该注册器仅针对给定的 Bean 工厂处理或测试套件被调用一次。
